movers.text: QB Kyler Murray (hamstring) doubtful; Carson Wentz (ankle) limited Wednesday. O'Connell not yet committed to newly acquired Kirk Cousins as Week 10 starter vs Packers.
QB Sam Darnold (quadriceps) out. Drew Lock expected to start vs Raiders; Macdonald said Lock's oblique tests were 'good' and he should manage it.
QB Gardner Minshew (elbow) on IR, season-ending UCL surgery. Rookie Carson Beck will start Sunday vs Rams per Mike LaFleur.
QB Malik Willis (core) placed on IR. Kyle McCord makes first NFL start Sunday at Indianapolis.
QB Jacoby Brissett expected to make Ravens debut as starter Monday vs Chargers per Jesse Minter; Joe Fagnano back to QB2. Lamar Jackson (thumb) on IR.

MIN.text: QB Kyler Murray (hamstring) doubtful; Carson Wentz (ankle) limited Wednesday. O'Connell not yet committed to newly acquired Kirk Cousins as Week 10 starter vs Packers.
TE T.J. Hockenson (wrist/chest) non-participant Wednesday; LB Blake Cashman in concussion protocol per Kevin O'Connell.

SEA.text: QB Sam Darnold (quadriceps) out. Drew Lock expected to start vs Raiders; Macdonald said Lock's oblique tests were 'good' and he should manage it.
OL: LT Charles Cross (ankle) and G Quenton Nelson (knee) both doubtful; each has missed recent games.

ARI.text: QB Gardner Minshew (elbow) on IR, season-ending UCL surgery. Rookie Carson Beck will start Sunday vs Rams per Mike LaFleur.
WR Michael Wilson (neck) on IR, out for season. C Hjalte Froholdt (concussion) and G Jon Gaines II (ankle) questionable.

MIA.text: QB Malik Willis (core) placed on IR. Kyle McCord makes first NFL start Sunday at Indianapolis.
DT Zach Sieler (biceps) placed on IR Tuesday. C Aaron Brewer (concussion) questionable.

LV.text: QB Fernando Mendoza takes over as starter Sunday vs Seahawks after Raiders traded Kirk Cousins to Minnesota; Aidan O'Connell now QB2.

CLE.text: QB Deshaun Watson (concussion) will start Sunday vs Texans, Browns announced Wednesday; Shedeur Sanders, who started Week 9, returns to backup.
WR Denzel Boston (toe) absent from Thursday practice; CB Denzel Ward (quad) limited; S Ronnie Hickman in concussion protocol.

KC.text: QB Patrick Mahomes (right elbow/knee) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice after Sunday's injury scare. WR Xavier Worthy (hamstring) also full.

LAC.text: QB Justin Herbert (left middle finger, non-throwing hand) questionable; Jim Harbaugh said he 'should be good to go' Monday at Baltimore.

NYG.text: QB J.J. McCarthy (hip) was a full participant Tuesday; expected to play Thursday vs Commanders.

NO.text: RB Travis Etienne Jr. back at practice Wednesday ahead of Panthers game.

IND.text: OT Jalen Travis (knee) doubtful. Colts traded WRs Josh Downs and Keenan Allen Tuesday.

GB.text: LB Zaire Franklin (shin) doubtful; G Sean Rhyan (ankle) and OT Travis Glover (knee) questionable vs Vikings.

CAR.text: LB Jaelan Phillips and CB Will Lee III (both hamstring) estimated as full participants Wednesday after missing last game. CB Jaycee Horn (quad) on IR.

PIT.text: DT Derrick Harmon returned to practice from injured reserve Wednesday ahead of Bengals game.

BUF.text: OL: OTs Dion Dawkins (ribs), Alec Anderson (ankle), Spencer Brown (ankle) and C Connor McGovern (neck) questionable. CB1 Christian Benford (wrist) questionable.

NE.text: C Ben Brown (knee) and CB Carlton Davis (knee) out; RB Rhamondre Stevenson (knee) doubtful; WR A.J. Brown (knee), OT Morgan Moses (foot) questionable.

DET.text: QB Jared Goff (chest) limited Wednesday; WR Amon-Ra St. Brown (ribs) and S Brian Branch (hip) also limited, ahead of Patriots game in Munich.
CB D.J. Reed (hip) and C Cade Mays (ankle) have a 'way outside shot' to play vs Patriots. LB Jack Campbell (neck) on IR.

BAL.text: QB Jacoby Brissett expected to make Ravens debut as starter Monday vs Chargers per Jesse Minter; Joe Fagnano back to QB2. Lamar Jackson (thumb) on IR.
S Kyle Hamilton (hip) questionable; Minter said he 'looks fairly good.' CB Nate Wiggins (illness) and S Jaylinn Hawkins (knee) also questionable.

LA.text: WR: Puka Nacua (knee) won't play vs Cardinals; Davante Adams (hamstring, IR) targeting Nov. 25 return per McVay. G Steve Avila (hamstring) questionable.
CB Trent McDuffie (back) questionable, missed last game; Rams 'optimistic' he returns. DE Myles Garrett (knee) limited at Wednesday walkthrough.

HOU.text: LB Azeez Al-Shaair (groin/personal) absent from practice again Thursday; RB Woody Marks (knee) not spotted at Thursday practice.

JAX.text: WR Jakobi Meyers (ankle) and DE Travon Walker (ribs) did not practice Wednesday. C Robert Hainsey (concussion), G Ezra Cleveland (knee) questionable.

SF.text: Secondary: CBs Deommodore Lenoir (foot) and Renardo Green (back) both did not practice Wednesday ahead of Cowboys game.

NYJ.text: WR Garrett Wilson (concussion) questionable vs Bills after missing last game.

DAL.text: WR George Pickens (hamstring) returned to practice after missing last game; LB DeMarvion Overshown (hamstring) also questionable.

TEN.text: WR Carnell Tate (shoulder) sat out Wednesday after missing last game; LB Anthony Hill Jr. (neck) also DNP. OT JC Latham (finger) full.
